name: Liqoria
soft_passes: #1 fills squircle but ships pre-masked with baked specular gloss the system should own
#4 charcoal play triangle survives 16px, but the orb dissolves into the field at small sizes
#7 glyph-vs-orb contrast strong; orb-vs-background ~1.1:1 (<3:1) — device barely separates from field
#8 layer order and top-down light are consistent, but low orb/field contrast collapses the depth illusion below hero size
#11 a device exists (glass-bubble play button) but it is a generic gloss trope, template-default not committed
failures: #9 era incoherence: a baked-gloss skeuomorphic orb inside an otherwise flat Big-Sur squircle, committing to neither language
#10 baked single-appearance PNG, not layered Icon Composer; light field + dark glyph would not adapt to dark/clear/tinted modes
light_model: Single top-down source: background lighter at top, glossy orb carries a baked specular highlight near its crown fading to mid-gray at base with weak contact grounding; specular is painted in, not system glass
layer_stack: light-gray squircle field with subtle top-down ramp
glossy pearlescent glass orb (baked specular highlight + soft lower reflection)
devices: play button embedded in a glossy glass bubble/orb (Aqua-glass-button quotation)
rhymes_hint: generic 'glossy orb + play triangle' media-player icons; skeuomorphic Aqua glass-button quotations transplanted into a modern squircle
notes: Source is a 204x204 web render (small); corners transparent -> ships pre-masked as a squircle, all hexes (estimated). Palette/brand incoherence: app cover is saturated Liquid Glass (translucent media widget on pink/purple floral wallpaper) while the icon is fully grayscale — the icon communicates neither the music subject beyond the play glyph nor the product's actual colour world. Baked gloss + pre-masked shape + no dark/tinted variant all fight the macOS 26 layered/system-effect pipeline.
